Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers about choosing lighting, requesting samples and placing orders for your projects or product range.

TOPIC 01

Products & applications

Find the product families and configurations that suit your space.

What products does ELVARO supply?

We offer LED strip lights, downlights, spotlights, magnetic track lighting, cabinet and wardrobe lighting, LED backlighting, power supplies and landscape lighting. Browse the product categories to find a starting point.

Who do you work with?

We work with lighting importers and distributors, lighting designers, contractors, hospitality project teams, system integrators and brands developing their own lighting ranges.

Where can I download your product catalogue?

Visit our catalogue page for the PDF. Send us the product references you are interested in so we can confirm the current specifications and availability.

Are all the products shown online available to order?

Send us the model number or a link to the product. We’ll confirm whether it is available, which configurations can be ordered and whether it requires a minimum quantity.

Which products suit hotels, retail spaces or architectural projects?

For hotels, start with downlights, accent spotlights and concealed linear lighting. For retail, consider adjustable spotlights or track lighting. For façades and landscape projects, share the installation conditions so we can review suitable outdoor options.

Can I order a complete lighting system with compatible accessories?

Tell us the fixture or strip model, installation layout and quantities. We can review the matching drivers, tracks, connectors, profiles or sensors available for that configuration and list them in the quotation.

TOPIC 02

Project design & technical files

Get the information your design, specification and installation teams need.

Can you help with product selection from a drawing or fixture schedule?

Yes. Send your drawings, fixture schedule or reference images, along with ceiling heights, mounting conditions, target light levels and project location where available. We can review suitable models and flag details that need confirmation before you specify them.

Can you provide datasheets, dimensional drawings and installation instructions?

Share the exact model and configuration. We’ll confirm which datasheets, drawings and installation guides are available and identify any dimensions you need to verify on site.

Can you provide IES or LDT files for DIALux or other lighting calculations?

Tell us the model, beam angle, output configuration and preferred file format. We’ll confirm whether a matching photometric file is available so your designer can model the proposed fixture.

Can you suggest an alternative for a specified fixture or an existing installation?

Send the original model, cutout or mounting dimensions, beam angle, light output, electrical requirements and a photo or drawing. We can review a potential alternative for your team to check against the project requirements.

Can you share examples of similar projects?

Tell us the application and the type of installation you are planning. You can start with the project experience section and ask us for any additional references we can share for your application.

TOPIC 03

Specifications, drivers & controls

Check the optical, electrical and mechanical details before ordering.

What colour temperatures, CRI values and beam angles can I order?

Options vary by model. Tell us your target colour temperature (CCT), colour rendering (CRI), beam angle and light output. We’ll confirm which combinations are available for the selected model.

How do I specify consistent colour across a project or repeat order?

Share your colour temperature, colour tolerance or SDCM target and any approved reference sample. For repeat orders, include the previous order or batch reference so we can review colour matching before production.

Are your fixtures dimmable or compatible with smart controls?

Compatibility depends on the fixture, driver and control system. Tell us your required protocol or dimmer model, input voltage and dimming needs so we can check the exact combination before you order.

Is a driver included with the fixture?

Check the quotation for the items included. Tell us your local supply voltage and preferred control method so we can confirm the driver specification and whether it is supplied with the fixture or quoted separately.

How do I choose a power supply for an LED strip run?

Share the strip model, voltage, power per metre, total length and layout, including the longest individual run. We can review the power supply and proposed feed points with you. Confirm the final wiring against the product instructions and site conditions before installation.

How do I plan a long LED strip run and manage voltage drop?

Send your strip model, run lengths, cable lengths and proposed power supply positions. We can review the model’s rated run length and whether the layout calls for shorter sections or additional feed points.

Are your outdoor products waterproof?

Check the IP rating and installation instructions for the exact model. Tell us how the fixture, cables, connections and power supply will be exposed. Each part of the installation needs to be suitable for its location.

Will your magnetic track fixtures fit my existing track?

Send the track brand, system voltage, dimensions and photos of the rail and connector. We’ll review the electrical and mechanical fit. If compatibility is uncertain, verify it with a sample before ordering.

How do I select LED backlighting for a stretch ceiling or illuminated panel?

Share the panel dimensions, diffuser material, cavity depth and target brightness. We can review the light source and spacing. A mock-up can help you check uniformity and hotspot visibility with the actual diffuser.

TOPIC 04

Quality & compliance

Identify the documents and checks required for your order.

What compliance documents can you provide for my market?

Tell us the destination market, exact model and required standard or document. We’ll confirm which conformity documents or test reports are available and whether they cover the proposed model, driver and configuration.

Does a compliance document cover every model in a product family?

Check the model list and the tested configuration on each document. If your order uses a different driver, housing or other option, ask us to confirm which documentation applies to that combination.

Can we agree on inspection criteria before production?

Share your acceptance criteria when requesting a quote, including the approved sample, appearance, dimensions, electrical performance, labelling and packing. We can review which checks can be included for the order.

Can I arrange a third-party pre-shipment inspection?

Send the inspection scope and timing before placing the order. We’ll review whether it can be accommodated and confirm the arrangements with you.

TOPIC 05

Quotes, samples & orders

Get a quote and confirm the commercial details before committing.

What should I include in a request for quotation?

Send the model numbers or a fixture schedule, quantities by configuration, destination and required delivery date. Include any drawings, control requirements, packaging details and required documents. Request a quote to share your requirements.

Can I order a sample first? Are samples free?

We generally charge a sample fee. Tell us which products and configurations you need, and we’ll prepare a quote based on your requirements.

What is your minimum order quantity? Can I place a trial or mixed order?

Yes, mixed-model orders are possible. Minimum order quantities and trial-order options depend on your quantities and requirements.

How do I check stock or confirm a production lead time?

Send your model, configuration, quantity and target date. We’ll confirm current availability and the estimated dispatch date for that order. Allow for transit time separately when planning installation.

What payment terms and currencies do you accept?

Ask us to confirm the quotation currency, available payment terms and order milestones. Refer to your written quotation or pro forma invoice for the terms that apply to your order.

How can I reorder a previous model or request distributor pricing?

For repeat orders, send the prior order reference and any required changes. For distributor pricing, share your market, preferred product range and expected order quantities so we can review the request.

TOPIC 06

OEM, ODM & private label

Define what you want to customise and how samples will be approved.

Do you offer OEM and ODM services?

Yes. We can review adaptations to existing products and discuss new product concepts. Send a technical brief, drawings or a reference sample so we can assess feasibility and outline the sampling process.

What can I customise?

Depending on the product, options may include dimensions, mounting details, housing finish, optics, colour temperature, driver and control configuration. Tell us which specifications are essential and which can be adjusted.

Can you use my logo, model labels and packaging design?

Yes. Please send your artwork, label requirements, instructions for the product manual and packaging specifications.

Can I approve a prototype before mass production?

We can review the sample approval process for your project. Agree on the features and tests to be checked before approval, including finish, dimensions, light output, labelling and packaging where relevant.

Are there tooling, development or artwork fees?

Fees depend on the scope of your project. You can ask us to itemise development, tooling, sampling and artwork fees in your quotation.

TOPIC 07

Shipping & export

Plan dispatch, delivery and the paperwork your importer needs.

Can you ship to my country, and what delivery options are available?

Yes. We can arrange sea, land and air freight. Please share your destination, order quantity and required arrival date. We’ll confirm the shipping options and trade terms available for your shipment.

Can I use my own freight forwarder or arrange a staged shipment?

Yes. Before placing your order, please tell us your preferred collection point, your freight forwarder’s requirements or the delivery schedule for each shipment.

What shipping documents can you provide?

We can provide a commercial invoice and packing list. Tell us what additional documents your destination requires so we can confirm what is available for your shipment.

Are freight, duties and taxes included in the quotation?

Ask us to itemise the freight charges included in your quotation and confirm who is responsible for import clearance, duties and other taxes under the agreed trade terms.

TOPIC 08

Warranty, spare parts & after-sales

Know what to confirm before ordering and what to send if there is an issue.

What warranty applies to my order?

We offer a one-year warranty. If you request on-site support from our technicians, you are responsible for all related expenses, including travel, accommodation and visa costs.

What should I do if products arrive damaged or items are missing?

Keep the packaging and send us the order reference, carton labels, affected quantities and photos of the products and packaging. We’ll review the details and confirm the next steps for your shipment.

How do I report a fault after installation?

Send the order reference, model and batch label if available, affected quantity and a description of the issue. Photos or video and details of the driver, controls and installation can help us identify the configuration and review next steps.

Can I order replacement drivers, accessories or spare parts?

Send the original model and order reference with a photo of the part or label. We’ll check current availability and confirm which replacement options are suitable for the original configuration.

Can I return or exchange items?

Contact us with the order reference, model, quantity and reason before arranging a return. We’ll review the request against the agreed order terms and confirm any applicable return arrangements.

Need help with a project or order?

Send us your model list, drawings or project requirements so we can review the options with you.
